rules.constraint: Keep credentials trusted; verify incoming events.
rules.task: Use provider docs for authenticity, retries and duplicate handling.
rules.acceptance: Forged/duplicate events cannot repeat side effects; valid events work.
rules.verification: Test fake and repeated events using provider fixtures; record limitations.

rules.constraint: Bound costly work and verify production transport/config.
rules.task: Reuse suitable request/resource limits; inspect deployment settings.
rules.acceptance: Repeated costly requests stay bounded; valid use works.
rules.verification: Test limits locally and inspect actual production config when authorized.
